|lore=“As a token of my good will, I present to you a gift: these two droids. Both are hardworking and will serve you well.”
|game_text=If you just moved a droid to Audience Chamber, deploy on table. You may not cancel battles. Force loss from Or Be Destroyed may not be reduced and is limited to 3. While Han with your non-'hit' Chewie, Lando, or Luke, Han may not be targeted by weapons. [Immune to Control.]
|errata_history=This is the original printed text of [[A Gift (V)]] (its only version). The image here is the Players Committee card image as first published. It is the current text. Each version below is quoted in full with its dated source. Every published image or slip that differs visibly from the one before is a version, numbered in release order; a printed errata mark that does not match that order is recorded as a PC transcription error (Bill, 12 November 2026). A same-words slip on a Players Committee release sheet that reprints a card image is part of that card image's version, not a version of its own (Bill, 17 November 2026).
* '''Original''' (this page): Players Committee card image first published 5 March 2023<ref name="ht-32e1135">Players Committee card image <code>Virtual21-Light/large/agift.gif</code> as published 5 March 2023: [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/holotable/32e11351311a33497ffb43a1612b36c3ae669e88/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual21-Light/large/agift.gif holotable commit 32e1135] “Fixing case and making gifs” (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009023430id_/https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual21-Light/large/agift.gif publisher copy, identical file].</ref>: “If you just moved a droid to Audience Chamber, deploy on table. You may not cancel battles. Force loss from Or Be Destroyed may not be reduced and is limited to 3. While Han with your non-'hit' Chewie, Lando, or Luke, Han may not be targeted by weapons. [Immune to Control.]”
*: The lower part of this card image (the bars and game-text box down to the lower-left name) was also printed as a slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 21 release sheet (first edition, June 2023)<ref name="sheet21-20230617">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-21.pdf Virtual Set 21 release sheet, June 2023 edition] (PDF, 8 pages, footer “”; file created 17 June 2023). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20230626152641/https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-21.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>, page 5, file created 17 June 2023, under the label “•A Gift”.
